title: 12 Best Feast on coconut-rich Malabar fish curry with appam and prawn pollichathu at a heritage home restaurant in Fort Kochi.
description: Discover Fort Kochi's finest heritage home restaurants for an authentic Malabar culinary journey. Indulge in exquisite fish curries, appam, and prawn pollichathu in historical settings. Your ultimate guide to dining in Fort Kochi.
category: Feast on coconut-rich Malabar fish curry with appam and prawn pollichathu at a heritage home restaurant

places.name: Malabar Junction (The Malabar House)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Malabar Fish Curry (Meen Moilee) with Appam, and their signature Prawn Pollichathu.

places.name: Brunton Boatyard - History Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Syrian Christian Fish Curry with appam, and Konkan Grilled Prawns.

places.name: Ginger House Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ginger Prawn Curry, Malabar Fish Fry, and Prawn Pollichathu.

places.name: The Old Courtyard Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kerala Fish Curry with Steamed Rice or Appam, and Pepper Prawns.

places.name: East Indies (Old Harbour Hotel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Catch of the Day (prepared in Malabar style), and Appam with Vegetable Stew or Fish Curry.

places.name: Oceanos Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Karimeen Pollichathu (Pearl Spot Fish), Malabar Prawn Curry, and fresh Appam.

places.name: Fort House Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kerala Fish Curry, Prawn Masala, and hot Appam.

places.name: Hotel Seagull
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fish Curry Meals (with a variety of side dishes), Prawn Roast, and fresh catches from the market.

places.name: Qissa Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'Curry of the Day' which often features a local fish curry, or their Prawn Vada.

places.name: Forte Kochi - Jetty Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kerala Fish Molle, Prawn Fry with Curry Leaves, and soft Appam.

places.name: Kashi Art Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order While mostly known for breakfast, ask if they have a Prawn Curry or Fish Fry as a special. Their fresh juices are excellent.

places.name: Fusion Bay
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Malabar Fish Curry, Prawn Pollichathu, and Appam or Malabar Parotta.

tags: Feast on coconut-rich Malabar fish curry with appam and prawn pollichathu at a heritage home restaurant
